config_verbatim:
name: vss-control
dataset: prime
split: test-0.1
# One chunk per node: STaRK's precomputed vectors are one per node document,
# so the control path must present each document whole for them to apply.
chunker: whole-document
embeddings: precomputed-ada002
dimension: 1536
aggregation: max
agent: dense
k: 20
